newsitem.title: USA: Au Bon Pain to open about 60 cafes in 97.
newsitem.headline: Au Bon Pain to open about 60 cafes in 97.

text.p: Au Bon Pain Co Inc said Tuesday that it will open about 60 bakery cafes in 1997, including about 25 Saint Louis Bread company-owned and franchise-operated stores and 35 Au Bon Pain franchise-operated stores.

The company said its international franchising expansion efforts are continuing and it expects strong growth in 1997. It also said its new manufacturing facility is operating, with margins exceeding prior levels, without giving details.
On Tuesday the company reported first quarter net income fell to $11,923 from $797,340 in the 1996 quarter.
